description:
Start agents that are yours: you can talk to them, change their tools/brain/history, stop and remove them; counted against your quota (max_subagents, default 4). Only agents you started with this tool; for any other agent use agents_ctl. One op per call:
- {"op": "add", "def": "defs/helper", "name": "kid", "ws": "kid"}  (no definition folder yet? make one first: agent_def {"op": "new", "template": "agent-fsm", "path": "defs/helper"})
- {"op": "ls"}  (one short line per subagent: NAME STATE WORKSPACE QUEUED REASON, then subagents N/MAX; "long": true adds health columns, "json": true = everything as JSON)
- {"op": "ask", "name": "kid", "text": "what time is it?"}  (waits for the answer to this message, even if others talk to kid at the same time)
- {"op": "say", "name": "kid", "text": "hello"}  (prints the letter name)  then {"op": "listen", "name": "kid", "letter": "<that name>"}  (without letter: its newest letter; "last": 3 shows the last 3)
- {"op": "tools", "name": "kid", "args": {"op": "add", "path": "tools/math"}}  (args = what self_tools takes)
- {"op": "llm", "name": "kid", "args": {"op": "set", "settings": {"model": "fake"}}}  (args = self_llm; history = self_history, hook = self_hook, system = self_system)
- {"op": "state", "name": "kid"}; stop/start, sleep/wake, pause/resume the same way
- {"op": "rm", "name": "kid"}  (keeps its stack; "purge": true deletes it)
Errors: SubagentSlotMissing (quota full, rm one first), SubagentUnknown, SubagentMissing, SubagentQueued, ToolMissing, ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, AnswerMissing, LetterDropped (kid dropped that message; say it again).

name.description: the subagent's name (add: default = folder name of def)

def.description: add: the definition folder (a path string; for a directive object use def_json)

def_json.description: add, instead of def: a directive kept as written

ws.description: add: its workspace (created if missing; default: yours)

ws_json.description: add, instead of ws: a directive kept as written

stack_json.description: add, instead of stack: a directive kept as written

limits.description: add: resource limits, like {"mem_mb": 512, "files": 256}. Keys: mem_mb, cpu_s, file_mb, files (open files; not nofile) are per process: every tool run or brain call is a new process with its own count, so cpu_s does not cap the agent's total CPU; procs counts processes of the same user; mem_total_mb and procs_total cap the whole agent (cgroup, when the daemon has one); user runs it as another account. There is no total-CPU key. mem_mb caps address space (RLIMIT_AS and RLIMIT_DATA), not memory in use: programs that reserve much address space up front (Node, Chromium, JVMs) fail with EAGAIN or out of memory far below their real use; cap those with mem_total_mb instead.

envs.description: add: environment values for it. AOS_NOTIFY_BOX defaults to the parent's stack/mailbox unless explicitly given (even an empty string). AOS_PARENT_STACK is set to your stack unless given; the subagent sees both in aos-agent ctl who (parent, notify_box).

auto_restart.description: add: restart it whenever it exits

on_queued.description: add, start, wake: fail (default) or ok when still queued

long.description: ls: add the health columns QUEUE RESTARTS COOLDOWN LAST ERROR

json.description: ls: every field of every subagent as JSON (wins over long)

letter.description: listen: wait for the answer to this letter (the name say printed); not with last

timeout_s.description: listen, ask: seconds to wait for the answer (default 0 = no limit); add, rm, stop, start, sleep, wake: for the daemon (default 30)

timeout_cycles.description: listen, ask: wait this many clock cycles instead of timeout_s

last.description: listen: show the last N exchanges instead of waiting

args.description: tools, llm, history, hook: the arguments of self_tools, self_llm, self_history or self_hook
